scope.name: Wong Tai Sin / Diamond Hill
scope.networkBoundary: Official DCCA union plus declared context buffer

graph.routingMethod: A* over complete enabled directed Wong Tai Sin / Diamond Hill 3DPN subset
graph.selectionMethod: Edge midpoint inside 25 official 2019 DCCAs or their 600 m context buffer

residentialBuildingAudit.classificationPolicy: Positive CSDI OP domestic GFA/type or explicit residential building-name evidence

attachments.runtimeHomeMethod: Synthetic homes sample positive-evidence CSDI residential building anchors inside the target DCCAs and attach to primary component 0

source.dataset: Hong Kong Lands Department 3D Pedestrian Network Phase 2

regionalPopulationEvidence.method: 2021 Census DCCA age-band proxy restricted to model ages 6-16

runtime.loadMode: bounded parallel fetch followed by typed-array CSR assembly
runtime.pathCache: Scenario, heat coefficient and OD keyed least-recent insertion cache

supported: All selected Wong Tai Sin / Diamond Hill 3DPN nodes and edges are retained in compressed chunks
Chunk boundaries preserve global graph topology
Target-DCCA school and child POI endpoints are snapped to the primary routable component
Synthetic homes use official CSDI building positions with positive residential-use evidence
Walking trips use an actual directed 3DPN origin-destination A* path
limitations: Household membership and home assignment are synthetic; no observed child address is used
A straight connector links each place coordinate to its snapped 3DPN node
AccessTime records are retained by ID but temporal opening restrictions are not yet evaluated
Network edges outside the declared DCCA union and context buffer are not included
A regional stress graph is evidence for reusable expansion, not a claim of simultaneous whole-Hong-Kong behavioural simulation

acceptanceGates: All 25 official H-code DCCAs resolve from the frozen geography bundle
Graph topology remains connected across at least two source 2 km tiles
Every retained edge endpoint resolves to exactly one dense graph node
All released school, POI and residential endpoints attach to the primary routable component
At least one exact directed A* route crosses a source-tile boundary
Legacy Hong Kong Island graph and model validators remain passing
The browser distinguishes source readiness, stress-region proof and pending whole-Hong-Kong behavioural integration

claimBoundary.supported: Reusable regional graph construction and exact cross-tile 3D pedestrian routing are demonstrated with official data.
claimBoundary.notSupported: V12.8 does not claim that all 452 DCCAs run simultaneously, that harbour crossings are walkable, or that whole-Hong-Kong behaviour is calibrated.
